review_kind: Fresh manual source/path/dependency review; no new compile/EVM/test run

lifecycle.case: First activation; desired OFF or ON
lifecycle.expected: No replacement snapshot; mint one main; record desired geometry as applied. ON permits no residual.

lifecycle.case: Growth in one/two legs; inside/mixed/fully outside
lifecycle.expected: Increase main only; both-leg aggregate valuation/shares handled upstream; residual ID/L/ticks and clock stay unchanged.
Budget replacement=false; increase existing main only; no aux minted, no continuously enforced60/40 floor.
Harvest/close every existing leg; snapshot replacement=true; route/mint active single main atomically; delete old association/count.
Same whole-close; at most one side excess can mint aux if useful. Main floor is replacement-only captured valuation, not forced residual40%.
Budget phase0 is ordinary replacement context too; destination policy controls new one/two legs. Source both close; no old residual retained.

lifecycle.case: Park then governed resume; destination ON/OFF
lifecycle.expected: Park closes both; resume starts from attributed idle plus compound and same ordinary replacement context, may create destination aux if enabled.
Emergency excludes ordinary/hybrid permission even if desiredON. Closes any current legs and creates one main. Mode remains unchanged.
Harvest both then burn only aux into same-bucket attributed idle; clear association/count. Main/shares/clock/mode unchanged. Return may contain both currencies.

lifecycle.case: Desired OFF but old aux exists
lifecycle.expected: Physical aux stays authenticated/valued/collected until actual successful close/merge. Setter does not move capital.

lifecycle.case: Residual close while desiredON then later rebuild wanted
lifecycle.expected: No forced immediate recreation. Same-value enabled configureResidualSide advances geometry for a later guarded whole replacement.
Every leg closes; no residual count/association survives; exact attributed principal is distinct from earned rewards/buyback. No reopening.
No legitimate live residual allowed at handoff boundary; ordinary resume after compatible parked import can later create aux.

lifecycle.case: Failure on first/second mint/burn/transfer/refund or final condition
lifecycle.expected: Full EVM rollback preserves old IDs/ownership/backing/mappings/count/nonce; governance policy setter mined earlier remains changed.

lifecycle.case: No feasible residual geometry or size
lifecycle.expected: <=0.1% leftovers or zero computedL deliberately skip mint; infeasible positive gap/range rejects guarded adjustment atomically; change reviewed policy or use existing raw recovery.

physical_invariants: secondaryId(main) and private primaryOfSecondary(aux) are assigned together only after actual owners/keys/ticks/L match planned mint; deleted together only after burn succeeds.
activeSecondaryCount counts registered residuals regardless of in-range/fill state; cap4 matches maximum four custody buckets; fills/reversals do not change it.

At all legitimate creation contexts the residual lies inside main bounds; main-outside/residual-active and both-outside-opposite-sides are unreachable absent corrupt/malicious dependency observations.
Main/residual token amounts are summed, never rawL. LP token ranges do not mutate when prices or desired policy change.
Both typed mint actions precede SETTLE_PAIR; IDs are read after approvals. Pinned hookless PositionManager increments IDs synchronously, and postconditions reject altered owner/key/ticks/L.
Ordinary final mint checks stored tick, not only sqrt, before/after callbacks. Residual initial gap remains strictly outside spot, including downward exact-tick semantics.
Only fixed Manager can call typed child; only Vault owns/approves LP IDs. No generic executor, caller-chosen recipient, direct principal claim or new governance sweep is introduced.
legitimate_market_classes: Price below main: both positions inactive on same asset side.
Price inside main and outside residual: main active; residual one-sided/inactive.
Price in residual: both active; residual mixed as it traverses.
Price beyond residual but inside main: main active; residual fully converted/inactive.
Price above main: both inactive on same asset side.
Trend/reversal alters inventory and values, not IDs/L/count; next adjustment harvests/closes/rebuilds all actual legs.
known_limits: A deliberately infeasible gap/width/mainfloor can block ordinary replacement but raw residual close/parking/terminal exit remain separate paths if token/core dependencies work.
Raw close cannot recover through a permanently broken token/core/chain; no universal liveness claim.
Malicious/upgradable token or compromised core may generate late fees between harvest and burn; accounting agent is reproducing this separately with explicit upstream-compromise scope.
No claim that partial residual allocation prevents all MEV or reduces IL in every market.
Normal core/periphery behavior and local fixture behavior must not be conflated; current public docs reference newer website structure but pinned installed source is authoritative.
useful_missing_composition_tests: Destination hybridON during same-pair move (source closes both, destination can create aux).
Parked resume hybridON after residual-filled/mixed/closed state.
Late-fee callback between main burn and residual burn: distinguish supported pinned token behavior from external-dependency compromise.
